recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast headshot of a man with hyper-realistic aged features, characterized by a cool cyan top-down light and a warm, subtle amber rim light against a void-like black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan highlights vs. deep black shadows
Textured grey hair vs. smooth dark clothing
Intense eye contact vs. somber facial expression
Warm rim light vs. cool primary key light

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally framed head and shoulders, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Light catches the top of the hair, draws down to the eyes, and follows the beard line to the subtle amber rim light on the right shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Total black negative space surrounding the subject, emphasizing isolation.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Amber/Warm Yellow (subtle rim light on the lower right)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to cyan, amber, and grayscale

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail portrait of an aged man with a grey afro and beard. Use a single cyan light source from above and a faint amber rim light from the side. Set against a pure black background with visible skin pores and wrinkles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, thin sans-serif font in a muted grey or cyan, placed in the lower third to avoid obscuring the face.

verificationChecks: Is the primary light source cyan?

adjustableVariables: Density of the beard and hair texture
Prominence of the amber rim light
mustRedesign: Ensure the eyes are not lost in shadow

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in hair and skin

postGenerationChecks: Check for cyan color cast on the hair highlights.
Verify the presence of the subtle amber light on the neck/shoulder.
Confirm the expression is somber and weary.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Chiaroscuro + Cyan Top Light + Amber Rim Light + Aged Texture + Black Void
